sources.entry: Headroom - Fast disk space analyzer with a treemap and duplicate finder that labels caches and developer folders Safe, Caution or Never before you delete them. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/Ryware/Headroom) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: Headroom
summary.one_liner: Headroom is a free, open source Mac disk cleaner that analyzes disk usage with a treemap, finds duplicates, and offers one-click cleanup with safety labels.
use_cases: free up disk space on a Mac
find large folders taking up storage
clean up node_modules and Xcode DerivedData
let an AI agent or script find reclaimable space
summary.what_it_does: Headroom scans a Mac's disk and shows where space is used with a treemap view. It includes a duplicate finder and one-click cleanup. It labels caches and developer folders as Safe, Caution or Never before deletion. A command-line mode (headroom cleanup) outputs scan results as JSON with total reclaimable space, candidate paths, sizes and safety ratings. The page says it uses the same scanner and safety rules as the app.
notable: Open source and free with no Pro tier or subscription
Safety labels (Safe, Caution, Never) on caches and developer folders before deletion
JSON command-line output designed for agents and scripts
caveats: Mac-only; the page names no other platforms
Safety labels are the app's own rating, so review candidates before deleting
